---
title: "eds213-job-risk"
format: html
---

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
# AI Pentration Score by Sector 
conn <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir = "job_risk.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)

sector_risk <- dbGetQuery(conn, "
  SELECT meds_jobs.sector,
         ROUND(AVG(task_penetration.penetration), 3) AS avg_ai_penetration,
         COUNT(*) AS num_tasks
  FROM meds_jobs_tasks
  JOIN task_penetration
    USING (task)
  JOIN meds_jobs
    USING (job_title)
  GROUP BY meds_jobs.sector
  ORDER BY avg_ai_penetration DESC;
")

DBI::dbDisconnect(conn, shutdown = TRUE)
```

```{r}
sector_risk |>
  arrange(avg_ai_penetration) |>
  mutate(sector = factor(sector, levels = sector)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = sector, y = avg_ai_penetration)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = sector, yend = 0), linewidth = 1.3, color = "darkblue") +
  geom_point(size = 6, color = "darkblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Average AI Task Penetration Score",
    title = "Which Sectors Are Most At Risk For AI Automation?",
    subtitle = "Ranked by average AI task penetration score across MEDS job postings"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray40"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11)
  )
```

```{r}
conn <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir = "job_risk.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)

position_risk <- dbGetQuery(conn, "
  SELECT meds_jobs.position_type,
         ROUND(AVG(task_penetration.penetration), 3) AS avg_ai_penetration,
         COUNT(*) AS num_tasks
  FROM meds_jobs_tasks
  JOIN task_penetration
    USING (task)
  JOIN meds_jobs
    USING (job_title)
  GROUP BY meds_jobs.position_type
  ORDER BY avg_ai_penetration DESC
  LIMIT 10;
")
DBI::dbDisconnect(conn, shutdown = TRUE)
```

```{r}
position_risk |>
  filter(!is.na(position_type)) |>
  mutate(position_type = str_to_title(position_type)) |>
  arrange(avg_ai_penetration) |>
  mutate(position_type = factor(position_type, levels = position_type)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = position_type, y = avg_ai_penetration)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = position_type, yend = 0), linewidth = 1.3, color = "darkgreen") +
  geom_point(size = 6, color = "darkgreen") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Average AI Task Penetration Score",
    title = "Which Position Types Are Most At Risk For AI Automation?",
    subtitle = "Ranked by average AI task penetration score across MEDS job postings"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray40"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11)
  )
```
